description: Source code for the IntentDialogFragment class, which displays a dialog with activity name and intent flags, and provides options to move or kill tasks.

classes.name: IntentDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass that shows activity name and intent flags, with options to move or kill the associated task.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IntentDialogFragment with specified activity name, flags, and task ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment with arguments: activity name, flags, and task ID.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up the dialog title, list view, and button click handlers.

methods.name: removeTask
methods.description: Removes the task with the specified task ID from recent tasks.

methods.name: moveTaskToFront
methods.description: Brings the task with the specified task ID to the front.
